name.description: Name of this tenant in the tenants list.

defaultTenant.description: Tenant to select when this folder opens. Use a name from tenants.

tenants.description: Named tenant connections available in this folder.

folder.description: Optional project folder for this tenant. Normally omitted in folder mode.

environments.description: DEV / TEST / PROD orgs for this client. When set, the active environment's org is used everywhere.

name.description: Short label like DEV, TEST, PROD.

defaultBrowser.description: Browser to use for maker portal links. Omit to use the system default browser.

defaultProfile.description: Firefox profile name passed with -P when defaultBrowser is firefox.

protected.description: Ask before pushes, imports, publishing, and data changes here.

environment.description: Legacy single-connection setting. Named tenant entries use defaultEnvironment instead.

defaultEnvironment.description: Environment to select when this tenant opens. Use a name from environments. Switch Environment changes the current window without changing this default.

accounts.description: Microsoft account per environment name, set by Sign In As.

account.description: Microsoft account to sign in with for this client, e.g. nathan@clientdomain.com. Use "Sign In As…" on the client to set it. Empty: whichever account VS Code picks.

tenant.description: Optional Entra tenant ID or domain, for a guest account in the client's tenant (Web API sign-in only).

solutions.description: Solution unique names shown in the Solutions tree (not display names).

entities.description: Extra tables for JS form types when solutions don't include them.

scriptNamespace.description: Root namespace for new form scripts, e.g. "Contoso". Defaults to the folder name.

webResourceRoots.description: Folders (relative to this client folder) whose relative file paths are web resource names, e.g. ["src/WebResources"].

outDir.description: Output folder relative to this client folder. A builderSettings.json here takes priority.

plugins.description: Plug-in assembly or package IDs by assembly name, for assemblies not found in the solution folder.

fileTables.description: Table each script works with, by path relative to this client folder, e.g. {"src/WebResources/cr36f_AccountFormOnLoad": "account"}. Used for column completions when the file name doesn't make it obvious.
